operation.description:
Users with push access can lock an issue or pull request's conversation.

Note that, if you choose not to pass any parameters, you'll need to set `Content-Length` to zero when calling out to this endpoint. For more information, see "[HTTP method](https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/getting-started-with-the-rest-api#http-method)."

default.summary: Example of locking an issue as off-topic

lock_reason.description:
The reason for locking the issue or pull request conversation. Lock will fail if you don't use one of these reasons:  
 * `off-topic`  
 * `too heated`  
 * `resolved`  
 * `spam`

#/components/parameters/issue-number.description: The number that identifies the issue.
#/components/parameters/issue-number.name: issue_number

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.
